evidence: Kernel-checked exact unbounded cooperation budget with a uniform physical repair for every width.

family.construction: Triangle with r copies of each of six original boundary leaves. The same two adjacent core vertices are hidden at every width.
family.lower_bound: Any history moving the retained core vertex while avoiding all boundary vertices outside an allowed set requires allowed.card >= r.
family.upper_bound: Allow the r copies of the first leaf to change. Three uniform partial-transposition phases give actual Kempe histories and restore every boundary leaf at the endpoint.
family.abstract_command: A single actual component switch in the retained graph. Both endpoint colourings have full extensions.

generic_theorem: Physical Kempe histories pull back along any graph homomorphism from a finite observing graph. The protected context pulls back too; each original switch may decompose into several observing components.
